verdict.rationale: The first-party manual documents a Commit Graph, reachable from the Repository screen, for exploring changes across branches. That directly matches the story's core, and the per-commit list actions in docs-14 and docs-17 add supporting history navigation. missing for 10: detail on what the graph renders (merge/branch lines, remote branches, tags, filtering or zoom), confirmation that it covers the full graph across all branches rather than a subset, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
